> Contractor in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (founded 8 Feb 2014) for insulated sandwich panel rooms and annexes (PUR 40 kg/m³), car parking shades (cantilever, German PVDF 1050g, Korean PVC 1100g, French fabrics, HF-welded), tensile shades, pergolas, privacy screens (iron, CNC laser-cut, Lexan, fabric), royal tents and majlis, Italian and metal qarmid, Lexan shades and screens, fences, and event tent and marquee installation.
